_comment: Reinforced Concrete: the aggregate comes back out when you crush it, which is the whole idea.
RED SAND SITS HERE BECAUSE THIS IS WHERE SAND AND GRAVEL ALREADY ARE (owner, 2026-08-20, #232).
It is also the only honest place for it. Red sand is IRON-STAINED sand - that is literally what
makes it red - and reinforced concrete is aggregate cast around steel that has been rusting in it
for however long this world has been over. The stain is the rebar. Nowhere else in the game puts
sand and iron in prolonged contact.
Weight 10 against sand's 20: the stained fraction is a minority of the aggregate, not half of it.
It is the only source of red sand in this world - vanilla generates it in badlands and nowhere
else, its block loot drops itself, and no recipe converts sand to red sand in either direction -
so this one entry closes the whole red sandstone family, eleven items.
It touches no gate. The concern #232 raised was that an iron-adjacent material might muddy the
iron gate (#91), but red sand only LOOKS ferrous: it smelts to glass like any sand and yields no
iron to anything. The gate is a property of the Cupola's recipe type and nothing here goes near it.
